subject: general
question: Which Indian Minister was listed among the top 10 most favoured global leaders in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi**, the current Prime Minister of India, has consistently ranked among the most popular leaders globally due to his impactful governance and leadership skills.
 
• He has been recognized for his initiatives such as **Digital India**, **Make in India**, and various policies aimed at economic growth and social welfare.
 
• Surveys and studies conducted internationally have often listed him among **the top 10 most favoured global leaders**, showcasing his global influence. *Hence, Narendra Modi is the correct answer.*
 
• His leadership has not only impacted India’s standing on the global stage but also contributed to strengthening India’s international relations with multiple countries.
 
• In **2025**, Narendra Modi is anticipated to continue influencing global perspectives through his policies and diplomatic efforts. *Hence, statement regarding Narendra Modi being listed among the top global leaders is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi’s Leadership:**

 
 
• **Narendra Modi**, born on **17 September 1950**, became Prime Minister of India in **2014** and has been re-elected due to his impactful governance and popularity.
 
• His government has launched landmark schemes like **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**, **Jan Dhan Yojana**, and **Ayushman Bharat**, which have received international recognition.
 
• Under his leadership, India has emerged as one of the fastest-growing economies globally, gaining attention from leaders across the world.
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition:**
 
 
• Narendra Modi has been acknowledged by platforms like **Time Magazine**, **Forbes**, and **Morning Consult Global Leader Approval Ratings**.
 
• He has consistently ranked as one of the **most popular leaders**, often ahead of other global leaders such as the President of the USA or the UK Prime Minister.
 
• **Example:** In **2023**, he topped the approval ratings with a score of over **76%**, showcasing his global and domestic popularity.
 
 
 
• **Impactful Policies:**
 
 
• Initiatives like **International Solar Alliance**, **G20 Presidency**, and **Neighborhood First Policy** have cemented India’s global presence under his leadership.
 
• His speeches at international forums like the **United Nations**, **World Economic Forum**, and **BRICS** have highlighted India’s role in global development and cooperation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Leaders in the List:**

 
 
• **Rahul Gandhi**: Known for his role as a leader in the opposition party, Congress. While popular in India, his global influence is limited compared to Narendra Modi.
 
• **Amit Shah**: A key figure in Indian politics, serving as the Home Minister. Though significant in India, his global recognition does not match Narendra Modi.
 
• **Manmohan Singh**: Former Prime Minister of India. He was globally acknowledged for his economic reforms during his tenure but is not listed among the most favoured global leaders in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Global Leadership Index:**
 
 
• Surveys like **Morning Consult** and **Gallup** often rank leaders based on approval ratings, policies, and global influence.
 
• Narendra Modi’s consistent performance in such surveys highlights his leadership skills and his ability to connect with people globally.
